bias.zh: 下降趋势 · 受制于 $155–158.6，仍在 5 日均线上方

read.en: Marvell fell 0.1% on Nov 10 to $154.39, trading $147.79–158.59. It is above the 5-day ($148.7) and below the 10-day ($175.3), 30-day ($228.4), 100-day ($229.2) and 200-day ($185.8); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 29 ($199.88), and RSI is 32.
read.zh: Marvell 11月10日下跌 0.1%，收于 $154.39，盘中区间 $147.79–158.59。股价位于 5 日（$148.7）均线上方，10 日（$175.3）、30 日（$228.4）、100 日（$229.2）和 200 日（$185.8）均线下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月29日起看空（$199.88），RSI 为 32。

read.en: No level changed: the $158.59 high pierced the $154.8–158 zone, but the close stayed just below it, and the $147.79 low held above $146.3–146.9. Resistance is $154.8–158.6 (Nov 4 and May 12 lows, Nov 9–10 highs), then $162.9 (Jul 29 low) and $171.4–175.3 (Nov 2–3 closes, 10-day). Support is $146.3–148.7, then $141.2–142.3 and $132.5–135.3. A close above $158.6 would target $163–171; below $146.3, $141–142.
